notes: §1985:VI.6.7.3 SR1: 'Procedure-name-1 is the name of a paragraph that contains a single sentence consisting of a GO TO statement without the DEPENDING phrase.' BindAlter resolves procedure-name-1 and reports COBOL1757 unless target.Range.IsParagraph and AlterIsSoleGoToParagraph (one sentence, one statement, a GO TO whose GoToFormats.Of is not Depending); probed at --std 85, a paragraph holding GO TO DEPENDING, no sentence, two sentences, an IF, a GO TO followed by a second statement or a CONTINUE is refused, a multi-paragraph section is refused, and a single GO TO (with a target or target-less, qualified or not) is accepted. The paragraph test is PcRange.IsParagraph (Start == End), which a SECTION holding exactly one paragraph also satisfies; BindAlter never reads ResolvedProcedure.IsSection, so ALTER section-name is accepted when that section's only paragraph is a single GO TO, and the GO TO of that paragraph is altered. Implemented for every shape of the paragraph's content; not implemented for the paragraph-versus-section distinction when the section has one paragraph. The witness refuses a paragraph whose sentence is DISPLAY followed by GO TO.

next.reason: 1985: "Procedure-name-1 is the name of a paragraph that contains a single sentence consisting of a GO TO statement without the DEPENDING phrase."; 2023: "No ALTER statement: no candidate covers it; the GO TO format (14.9.17.2) has only unconditional and DEPENDING forms, no ALTER target.". 2023 has no ALTER statement. No candidate comes from an ALTER clause, and none covers altering a paragraph that holds a single GO TO sentence, so the feature and its rule are gone.
